summary: The filing reports Veralto Corporation's issuance of $725 million aggregate principal amount of 4.850% Senior Notes due 2032 in an underwritten offering pursuant to an effective shelf registration statement. The notes were issued under an indenture with Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as trustee. Interest is payable semi-annually, and the notes are redeemable at the company's option prior to December 15, 2031 at a make-whole premium, and thereafter at par. Holders may require repurchase at 101% upon a change-of-control triggering event. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, or other corporate event is involved.
